# ADR-NNNN: Title that names the decision

> **Status:** proposed | accepted | superseded by [ADR-NNNN](NNNN-title.md) · **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD · **Deciders:** who · **Last reviewed:** YYYY-MM-DD

     Keep it to one page. An ADR records a decision that is hard to reverse or that a newcomer would question. -->

## Context

What problem or force made a decision necessary? Facts, constraints and the options that were real. Link to the design or review.

## Decision

What was decided, in one or two sentences, in the active voice ("We use ...").

## Consequences

* What becomes easier or better.
* What becomes harder, what it costs, what we accept.
* What would make us revisit this (the trigger).

## Alternatives considered

| Option | Why it was not chosen |
| --- | --- |
| ... | ... |

## References

* Links to the design document, review record, code, or external page.
